Vendored anyrender_vello_cpu for raea. Local changes:
- src/scene.rs: synthetic-bold embolden pre-scaled into font units for unhinted glyphs (glifo caches unhinted outlines at units-per-em size, so a pixel amount was ~upem/size times too small).
- src/scene.rs: unhinted glyph baselines snap to whole device pixels under axis-aligned transforms (Chrome's Skia positions horizontal text with x-only subpixel precision).
- src/skia_text.rs + src/scene.rs (feature `skia-text`, on with the renderer's `skia`): filled, solid-color glyph runs under an axis-aligned scale+translate are rasterized by anyrender_skia's own `draw_glyphs` into 8-bit masks (CoreText glyph masks on Apple platforms, as Chrome draws them), cached per thread (1024 masks / 16 MB) and composited as premultiplied images at integer offsets. Color fonts (sbix/COLR/CBDT/SVG) and fonts over 32 MB stay on outlines. `RAEA_OUTLINE_TEXT=1` disables it.
- src/skia_text.rs + src/scene.rs (`skia-text`): solid fills with curves, slanted lines or a rotated/skewed transform take Skia's antialiased coverage (`SkiaSceneCache::path_mask`), as Chrome rasterizes every path with Skia's scan converter; axis-aligned rectangles and shapes over 131,072 device pixels (bounding box) stay on vello. Path masks have their own per-thread budget (1024 masks / 32 MB). `RAEA_VELLO_PATHS=1` disables it.
